dog.description_text:
Meet Max!

Max arrived at ACC as a stray and is a friendly, playful dog who loves attention. He was a bit nervous at first but quickly warmed up, showing his sweet, wiggly personality.

My Ideal Home

We don't have a history on Max's behavior in a home environment, but he will thrive with daily mental and physical activity. Long-lasting chews, food puzzles, and hide-and-seek games, in addition to physical exercise, will help positively direct his energy and enthusiasm.

Things to Know

Max walks well on a leash with no pulling and is very receptive to treats. He enjoys human contact, leaning into staff for pets and belly rubs. He is currently receiving medication for a common respiratory illness, and staff can discuss his ongoing care.

Fun Fact

Max is a wiggly sweetheart who loves to try and lay in laps for belly rubs!

Max is available to a Level 1 adopter. He was brought to ACC by officers who found him in an apartment.
